sentences.text: CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH

--------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Randhir Kumar, Advocate For the State : Mr. Manoj Kr. Mishra, A.P.P  --------
04/ Dated 21.06.2023  Heard the parties.
The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Nawabazar P.S. Case No. 12 of 2023,
for the offences under Sections 414, 420/34 of the Indian Penal Code, Section 21 of Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, 1957, Rule 54 of Jharkhand Minor Mineral Concession Rules, 2004 and Rules 9(1), 13(1) of Jharkhand Mineral (Prevention of Illegal Mining,
Transportation and Storage) Rule, pending in the Court of Miss Apekchha, learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st class, Palamau.
The petitioner is the owner of a truck bearing registration No. JH02AK- 1466 which was seized by Nawabazar Police, loaded with 800 CFT of stone chips.
It was submitted that vehicle of the petitioner is a commercial vehicle and it was fully under the control of the driver.
It was further submitted that driver of the offending vehicle was transporting the seized stone chips without consent and knowledge of the petitioner.
It was also submitted that petitioner has got no criminal antecedent and this fact has been stated at paragraph-13 of the anticipatory bail application.

It was finally submitted that the co-accused Sunil Yadav has been granted anticipatory bail by this Court in A.B.A. No.2575/2023 vide order dated 27.04.2023 and the case of the petitioner stands on a similar footing.
Considering the aforesaid fact; I am inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

He is directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and the learned court below on his surrender shall release him on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like Suraj Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand ..... .... Opp
